scripts.title: ESP SCRIPT OPEN SOURCE RGB AUTO DETECT NEW OBJECTS
scripts.script:
-- made by mrpopcat14 in youtube 
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- Table to keep track of highlighted objects
local highlightedObjects = {}

local function handleNewObject(obj)
    if obj:IsA('Classname_here') and obj.Parent and obj.Parent:IsA('Model') and obj.Parent.Name == 'Parent name here' then
        -- Check if the object is not already highlighted
        if not highlightedObjects[obj] then
            if not obj.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass('BillboardGui') then
                local BillboardGui = Instance.new('BillboardGui')
                local TextLabel = Instance.new('TextLabel')

                BillboardGui.Parent = obj.Parent
                BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
                BillboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

                TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
                TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                TextLabel.Text = "Door" -- Display text
                TextLabel.TextScaled = true
                TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5 -- Text stroke for visibility



                local function updateColors()
                    local hue = tick() % 5 / 5 
                    local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
                    TextLabel.TextColor3 = color
                end

                RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateColors)

                highlightedObjects[obj] = true
            end
        end
    end
end

objects
local function handleExistingObjects()
    for _, obj in ipairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        handleNewObject(obj)
    end
end

game.Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    handleNewObject(child)
end)

local lastCheck = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    lastCheck = lastCheck + deltaTime
    if lastCheck >= 0.5 then
        handleExistingObjects()
        lastCheck = 0
    end
end)

handleExistingObjects()

scripts.script:
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local FrameUICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local UsernameUICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local TeleporttoPlayerUICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local Title = "Teleport GUI"
local Title2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local Username = Instance.new("TextBox")
local TeleporttoPlayer = Instance.new("TextButton")

gui.Parent = game.CoreGui
gui.Name = "TeleportGui"

Frame.Parent = gui
Frame.Name = "Teleport GUI"
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 217, 0, 140)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.781, 0, 0.732, 0)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = nil
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Selectable = true
Frame.Draggable = true

Title2.Parent = Frame
Title2.Name = "Title"
Title2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 215, 0, 30)
Title2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 0)
Title2.TextScaled = true
Title2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title2.Font = "FredokaOne"
Title2.Text = Title
Title2.BackgroundTransparency = 1

Username.Parent = Frame
Username.Name = "UsernameTextBox"
Username.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 33)
Username.Position = UDim2.new(0, 19, 0.25, 0)
Username.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 33, 33)
Username.ClearTextOnFocus = false
Username.PlaceholderText = "Username"
Username.Text = ""
Username.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Username.Font = "ArialBold"
Username.TextSize = 15

TeleporttoPlayer.Parent = Frame
TeleporttoPlayer.Name = "Kick"
TeleporttoPlayer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 33)
TeleporttoPlayer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 19, 0.62, 0)
TeleporttoPlayer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 33, 33)
TeleporttoPlayer.Text = "Teleport to Player"
TeleporttoPlayer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TeleporttoPlayer.Font = "ArialBold"
TeleporttoPlayer.TextSize = 15

TeleporttoPlayer.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local pl = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	local pl2 = Username.Text
	local humanoid = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	wait(0.1)
	pl.CFrame = game.Players[pl2].Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
end)

TeleporttoPlayerUICorner.Parent = TeleporttoPlayer
TeleporttoPlayerUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

UsernameUICorner.Parent = Username
UsernameUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

FrameUICorner.Parent = Frame
FrameUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
